in_sanskrit.name: एकतार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ektaara is a Sanskrit name composed of two roots: 'Ek' meaning 'one' and 'Taara' meaning 'goal' or 'purpose'. Thus, Ektaara can be interpreted as 'One with a goal' or 'One who has a purpose'.

in_hindi.name: एकतारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ektaara is a Hindi name which can be translated to 'One with a goal' or 'One who has a purpose'. The Hindi term 'Ek saath haath se vajanatmā' can be broken down into 'Ek' meaning 'one', 'saath' meaning 'with', 'haath' meaning 'hand', and 'vajanatmā' meaning 'weight' or 'burden'. Together, it can be interpreted as 'One who carries a weight on one hand', which metaphorically represents having a single-minded focus on a goal.

in_tamil.name: ஐக்தாரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ektaara in Tamil translates to 'One who has a goal' or 'One with a purpose'. The Tamil term 'ஐங்கு அல்லவள்ளியின் அடி' can be broken down into 'ஐங்கு' meaning 'one', 'அல்லவள்ளி' meaning 'goal' or 'purpose', and 'அடி' meaning 'hand'. This can be interpreted as 'One who holds a goal in one hand'.

in_telugu.name: ెక్౟ా౱ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ektaara in Telugu translates to 'One with a goal' or 'One who has a purpose'. The Telugu term 'ెప్పుడు మొద్దేశ్య' can be broken down into 'ెప్పు' meaning 'one', 'ప్పు' meaning 'goal', 'దు' meaning 'given', and 'మొద్దేశ్య' meaning 'giver'. Together, it can be interpreted as 'One who has a goal given by oneself', which can be understood as having a self-imposed purpose or goal.

in_marathi.name: Ektaara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ektaara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Symbolizing unity and strength, Ektaara is the name of the Goddess of Victory in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ek' meaning 'one' and 'taara' meaning 'star'.

in_bengali.name: Ektaara
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ektaara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Symbolizing unity and strength, Ektaara is the name of the Goddess of Victory in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ek' meaning 'one' and 'taara' meaning 'star'.
